description_en: Queries the list of join permissions rented by the current user account. The join permissions can be dedicated or roaming
description_zh: 查询当前用户账号所租用的入网凭证列表（可能是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）
name: ListRentedJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: fuzzy_owner_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by enabled or disabled status. A value of true indicates enabled. A value of false indicates disabled
parameters.help_zh: 按照凭证的启停用状态进行过滤。true表示启用，false表示停用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by whether they are associated with a node group. A value of true indicates associated. A value of false indicates not associated
parameters.help_zh: 根据入网凭证是否关联到节点分组进行过滤。true表示已关联，false表示未关联
parameters.name: bound_node_group

parameters.help_en:
Filters join permissions by type. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated join permission
ROAMING: roaming join permission
parameters.help_zh:
按照入网凭证的类型进行过滤，取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证
ROAMING：泛在凭证
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_permission_name

parameters.help_en: The offset of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从 0 开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of join permissions to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的入网凭证数量的上限，大于等于 1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为CREATED_MILLIS, 表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order when used with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of join permissions that match the filter conditions
List.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的入网凭证列表

BoundNodeGroup.description_en: Indicates whether the join permission is associated with a node group
BoundNodeGroup.description_zh: 入网凭证是否已关联到节点分组

BoundNodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the node group associated with the join permission
BoundNodeGroupId.description_zh: 入网凭证绑定的节点组id

BoundNodeGroupName.description_en: The name of the node group associated with the join permission
BoundNodeGroupName.description_zh: 入网凭证绑定的节点组名称

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the join permission. Valid values: A, B, and C
ClassMode.description_zh: 入网凭证采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，可取值：A、B、C

Enabled.description_en: The enabled or disabled status of the join permission
Enabled.description_zh: 入网凭证的启停用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the join permission
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 入网凭证采用的频段的频段ID

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

OwnerAliyunId.description_en:
If the join permission is a dedicated join permission, this field indicates the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the owner.
If the join permission is a roaming join permission, this field is always AliCloud IoT
OwnerAliyunId.description_zh:
如果该入网凭证是专用入网凭证，该字段表示拥有者的阿里云账号ID。
如果该入网凭证是泛在入网凭证，该字段恒为AliCloud IoT

RxDelay.description_en: The receive window delay for Class A

Type.description_en: The type of the join permission

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of join permissions that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的入网凭证总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
